$comment: Message catalogue. Keys are dotted paths, grouped by surface. This file is the complete English reference: it is what a missing translation falls back to, so a key missing from a translation degrades to readable English rather than to a raw key or a blank. When adding copy to the site, add it here first, then to the other catalogues. Placeholders are {name} and must survive translation untouched. Copy rules: no em dashes in prose, no 'X, not Y' constructions, one triad per page maximum.

nav.tellUs: Tell us what you're trying to solve

footer.body: Brand & product agency. We build the system behind your brand, then hand it over so your team can run it.

hero.body: Your team should be able to ship on-brand without us in the room. That's what the system is for.
hero.orFullForm: Or open the full enquiry form

intake.title: Tell us what you're trying to solve
intake.description: Tell us the situation and we'll understand it before recommending anything. No package required, no sales call to get a sales call.
intake.lede: You don't need to know what you need yet. Describe the situation, and we'll understand it first.
intake.step1Body: In your own words. No package to choose, no budget conversation up front.
intake.step2Title: We read it and assign it
intake.step2Body: A real person picks this up internally. You get a confirmation that it landed.
intake.step3Title: We work out the approach together
intake.step3Body: The right shape of engagement comes from understanding the problem, not from a price list.
intake.noSla: No response-time promise on this page. You'll hear from a person who has read your actual situation.

form.intro: Four things we need. Everything after them is optional.
form.messagePlaceholder: The more specific you are, the more useful our first reply will be. What have you already tried?
form.messageHint: {n} characters minimum. A sentence or two is enough.
